ex.en: Anyone who violates the traffic rules will be fined.
ex.zh: 任何违反交通规则的人都将被罚款。

words.note: violate 多接法律、权利、隐私等抽象对象。

ex.en: The federal government announced new funding for rural schools.
ex.zh: 联邦政府宣布为乡村学校提供新资金。

words.note: federal 指联邦中央一级，各州的法律称 state law。

ex.en: Please verify your identity before you can access the account.
ex.zh: 请先核实身份，然后才能登入账户。

words.note: verify 强调通过查证确认真伪，后面也可接 that 从句。

ex.en: The class went on a one-day excursion to the mountains.
ex.zh: 全班去山里进行了一日远足。

words.note: excursion 指有组织的短途出行，常与 go on 连用。

ex.en: The mayor will inaugurate the new library next Monday.
ex.zh: 市长下周一将为新图书馆举行开馆仪式。

words.note: inaugurate 指正式就职或启用，气势比 begin 隆重。

ex.en: The old factory has undergone major changes in the past decade.
ex.zh: 这家老厂在过去十年经历了重大变化。

words.note: undergo 过去式 underwent、分词 undergone，多接检查与手术。

ex.en: The police offered a reward for information about the missing painting.
ex.zh: 警方悬赏征集失踪画作的线索。

words.note: reward 后接 for 表原因；award 指颁发奖项，注意区分。

ex.en: Sheep graze quietly on the hillside above the village.
ex.zh: 羊群在村子上方的山坡上安静地吃草。

words.note: graze 兼指动物吃草与擦伤皮肤，看宾语判断词义。

ex.en: She cut the coupon from the magazine and saved ten percent.
ex.zh: 她从杂志上剪下优惠券，省了百分之十。

words.note: coupon 常与 use、redeem（兑换）连用。

ex.en: There are a multitude of reasons why students choose to study abroad.
ex.zh: 学生选择出国留学有诸多理由。

words.note: a multitude of 后接可数名词复数，比 many 更书面。

ex.en: Rare birds inhabit the wetlands along the coast.
ex.zh: 珍稀鸟类栖息在沿海湿地上。

words.note: inhabit 及物，直接接地点，不说 inhabit in；名词 inhabitant。

ex.en: The city was under siege for more than three months.
ex.zh: 这座城市被围困了三个多月。

words.note: siege 常与 lay、lift、under 搭配，也可比喻受围攻。

ex.en: Young children find abstract ideas such as time difficult to grasp.
ex.zh: 幼儿觉得时间这类抽象概念难以理解。

words.note: abstract 作名词指论文摘要；in the abstract 表抽象地看。

ex.en: Climate change is high on the agenda of this year's meeting.
ex.zh: 气候变化是今年会议的首要议题。

words.note: agenda 原为复数，现作单数用；on the agenda 常用。

ex.en: The peaceful protest soon degenerated into a violent clash.
ex.zh: 和平抗议很快演变成暴力冲突。

words.note: degenerate into 指局面变坏；作动词时重音在第二音节。

ex.en: Good teachers nurture curiosity rather than simply pass on facts.
ex.zh: 好老师培养好奇心，而不只是传授知识。

words.note: nature and nurture 是「先天与后天」的固定说法。

ex.en: The storm was so destructive that the village took years to recover.
ex.zh: 这场风暴破坏力极强，村庄多年才恢复。

words.note: de-（向下）+ struct（建造），与 constructive 相对。

ex.en: The singer made a brief appearance at the end of the show.
ex.zh: 演唱会结尾这位歌手短暂露面。

words.note: appearance 指露面或外表；to all appearances 表从外表看。

ex.en: The museum displays objects from cultures around the world.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆展出世界各地文化的器物。

words.note: culture 可数指不同文化；cell culture 指细胞培养。

ex.en: New fathers in this company can take two months of paternity leave.
ex.zh: 本公司的新爸爸可休两个月陪产假。

words.note: paternity 指父系、父子关系，与 maternity 相对。

ex.en: Don't make a hasty decision before you have all the facts.
ex.zh: 掌握全部事实前不要草率决定。

words.note: hasty 含贬义，指过于仓促；hurried 语气更中性。

ex.en: The donor chose to remain anonymous, so nobody knew where the money came from.
ex.zh: 捐赠者选择匿名，因此没人知道这笔钱的来源。

words.note: an-（无）+ onym（名），同根词 synonym、antonym。

ex.en: The dealer was arrested for selling fake paintings to tourists.
ex.zh: 这名画商因向游客出售假画被捕。

words.note: fake 作形容词最常用；伪造签名常说 forge a signature。

ex.en: His career spanned four decades and three continents.
ex.zh: 他的职业生涯跨越四个十年、三大洲。

words.note: span 指时间或空间跨度；life span 指寿命。

ex.en: Two officers escorted the visitors out of the building.
ex.zh: 两名警官把来访者护送出了大楼。

words.note: escort 作名词重音在前，作动词重音在后，读音不同。

ex.en: The witness gave a bizarre account of what happened that night.
ex.zh: 证人对那晚发生的事作了离奇的描述。

words.note: bizarre 指离奇得令人费解，语气比 strange 更强。

ex.en: The organization has been in existence for over fifty years.
ex.zh: 这个组织已存在五十多年。

words.note: come into existence 表开始存在；动词形式是 exist。

ex.en: Scientists ascribe the rise in temperature to human activity.
ex.zh: 科学家把气温上升归因于人类活动。

words.note: ascribe A to B 中 A 是结果、B 是原因；近义词 attribute。

ex.en: We are on the threshold of a new era in medicine.
ex.zh: 我们正处在医学新时代的开端。

words.note: threshold 指门槛或临界点；on the threshold of 表即将。

ex.en: A few fallen leaves were floating slowly down the river.
ex.zh: 几片落叶顺河缓缓漂下。

words.note: float 指浮在液体上或悬在空中；反义词是 sink。
